name: Lunar Lash
description: Lash a bar of pale light across a foe's guard and shove it back.

name: Reflecting Sheet
description: Hang a sheet of polished light that returns a blow to the one who threw it.

name: Draw Reading
description: Read every pull acting on a wide field to find the strongest foe in it.

name: Tide Rupture
description: Rupture a foe's tide of qi mid cast so it spills uselessly.

name: Darkened Moon
description: Dim the moon above a strong foe until it loses its sight and its footing.

name: Crushing Phase
description: Raise the pull to its crushing phase on a single foe and bear it to its knees.

name: Rolling Tide
description: Roll a heavy tide across the whole field in one long sweep.

name: Drawn Sky
description: Draw the sky's light down on a group of foes and pin each where it stands.

name: Orbit Capture
description: Take a lone champion into an orbit round the user and let the pull wear it down.

name: Lunar Rend
description: Pull a foe's guard apart from within with a single hard tug of moon force.

name: Phase Flash
description: Flash from one phase of the moon to the next and appear across the field.

name: Full Fall
description: The school's own fall of the full moon's weight whose crush grows with the user's reserve.

name: Falling Moon
description: Call the moon's whole pull down on the field so all in it fall and break to the destructive ceiling of a Xiantian master.
